CREATE TABLE "app_security"."user_identity" (
	"user_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "app_security"."user_identity_user_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"entra_tenant_id" uuid,
	"entra_object_id" uuid,
	"employee_id" varchar(100),
	"corporate_email" varchar(320),
	"given_name" varchar(150),
	"family_name" varchar(150),
	"resolution_status" varchar(20) DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_entra_pair" CHECK ((((entra_tenant_id IS NULL) AND (entra_object_id IS NULL)) OR ((entra_tenant_id IS NOT NULL) AND (entra_object_id IS NOT NULL)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_external_identity" CHECK (((employee_id IS NOT NULL) OR (corporate_email IS NOT NULL) OR (entra_object_id IS NOT NULL))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_resolution" CHECK (((resolution_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'RESOLVED'::character varying, 'CONFLICT'::character varying, 'DISABLED'::character varying])::text[])))
);
CREATE TABLE "app_security"."user_plant_access" (
	"entra_tenant_id" uuid,
	"entra_object_id" uuid,
	"plant_id" bigint,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"created_by" varchar(255) DEFAULT 'GBC_ACCESS_API' NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_by" varchar(255) DEFAULT 'GBC_ACCESS_API' NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "user_plant_access_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("entra_tenant_id","entra_object_id","plant_id")
);
CREATE TABLE "app_security"."user_plant_access_" (
	"user_id" bigint,
	"plant_id" bigint,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"valid_from" timestamp with time zone,
	"valid_to" timestamp with time zone,
	"granted_by_user_id" bigint,
	"grant_reason" varchar(500),
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "user_plant_access__pkey" PRIMARY KEY("user_id","plant_id","valid_from"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_plant_validity" CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from)))
);

	"user_shift_assignment_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "app_security"."user_shift_assignment_user_shift_assignment_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),

	"valid_to" timestamp with time zone,

	"assigned_by_user_id" bigint,
	"assignment_reason" varchar(500),
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_shift_status" CHECK (((assignment_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ACTIVE'::character varying, 'INACTIVE'::character varying, 'REASSIGNED'::character varying, 'CLOSED'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_user_shift_validity" CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from)))
);

	"catalog_audit_log_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "core"."catalog_audit_log_catalog_audit_log_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),

	"record_id" varchar(120) NOT NULL,
	"action" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
	"changed_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"changed_by_user_id" bigint,
	"old_values" jsonb,
	"new_values" jsonb,
	"source_system" varchar(50),
	"correlation_id" varchar(100),
	"reason" text,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_catalog_audit_action" CHECK (((action)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['INSERT'::character varying, 'UPDATE'::character varying, 'ACTIVATE'::character varying, 'DEACTIVATE'::character varying, 'DELETE'::character varying, 'REASSIGN'::character varying, 'IMPORT'::character varying])::text[])))
);

CREATE TABLE "core"."dough" (
	"dough_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "core"."dough_dough_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"plant_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"dough_code" varchar(80) NOT NULL,
	"dough_name" varchar(200) NOT NULL,
	"erp_description" varchar(250),
	"item_category" varchar(20),
	"is_test_dough" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"is_deleted" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	"deleted_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"source_system" varchar(50),
	"last_sync_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_dough_id_plant" UNIQUE("dough_id","plant_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_dough_plant_code" UNIQUE("plant_id","dough_code"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_category" CHECK (((item_category IS NULL) OR ((item_category)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['SUB'::character varying, 'SEMI'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying])::text[])))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_deleted" CHECK ((((is_deleted = false) AND (deleted_at IS NULL)) OR ((is_deleted = true) AND (is_active = false) AND (deleted_at IS NOT NULL))))
);

	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_changeover_duration" CHECK ((theoretical_duration_minutes >= (0)::numeric)),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_changeover_validity" CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from)))
);

CREATE TABLE "core"."dough_line_config" (
	"dough_line_config_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "core"."dough_line_config_dough_line_config_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),

	"line_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"production_rate" numeric(18, 6),
	"production_rate_uom_id" bigint,
	"yield_quantity" numeric(18, 6),
	"yield_uom_id" bigint,
	"startup_time_minutes" numeric(12, 4),
	"mixing_time_minutes" numeric(12, 4),
	"time_to_divider_minutes" numeric(12, 4),
	"time_to_wrapper_minutes" numeric(12, 4),
	"valid_from" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"valid_to" timestamp with time zone,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_dough_line_config_context" UNIQUE("dough_line_config_id","dough_id","line_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_dough_line_config_version" UNIQUE("dough_id","line_id","valid_from"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_line_rate" CHECK (((production_rate IS NULL) OR (production_rate >= (0)::numeric))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_line_times" CHECK ((((startup_time_minutes IS NULL) OR (startup_time_minutes >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((mixing_time_minutes IS NULL) OR (mixing_time_minutes >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((time_to_divider_minutes IS NULL) OR (time_to_divider_minutes >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((time_to_wrapper_minutes IS NULL) OR (time_to_wrapper_minutes >= (0)::numeric)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_line_validity" CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_line_yield" CHECK (((yield_quantity IS NULL) OR (yield_quantity >= (0)::numeric)))
);

);

CREATE TABLE "core"."item_line_config" (
	"item_line_config_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "core"."item_line_config_item_line_config_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"plant_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"item_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"line_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"relation_type" varchar(20) DEFAULT 'PRODUCES' NOT NULL,
	"production_rate" numeric(18, 6),
	"production_rate_uom_id" bigint,
	"primary_uom_id" bigint,
	"packages_per_uom" numeric(18, 6),
	"pieces_per_package" integer,
	"secondary_container_code" varchar(100),
	"uoms_per_secondary_container" numeric(18, 6),
	"target_weight_piece_kg" numeric(18, 6),
	"target_weight_package_kg" numeric(18, 6),
	"valid_from" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"valid_to" timestamp with time zone,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_item_line_config_context" UNIQUE("item_line_config_id","plant_id","item_id","line_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_item_line_config_version" UNIQUE("item_id","line_id","relation_type","valid_from"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_item_line_positive" CHECK ((((production_rate IS NULL) OR (production_rate >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((packages_per_uom IS NULL) OR (packages_per_uom > (0)::numeric)) AND ((pieces_per_package IS NULL) OR (pieces_per_package > 0)) AND ((uoms_per_secondary_container IS NULL) OR (uoms_per_secondary_container > (0)::numeric)) AND ((target_weight_piece_kg IS NULL) OR (target_weight_piece_kg > (0)::numeric)) AND ((target_weight_package_kg IS NULL) OR (target_weight_package_kg > (0)::numeric)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_item_line_relation" CHECK (((relation_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PRODUCES'::character varying, 'CONSUMES'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_item_line_validity" CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_to > valid_from)))
);

CREATE TABLE "core"."line" (
	"line_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "core"."line_line_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"plant_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"line_code" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
	"line_name" varchar(150) NOT NULL,
	"erp_line_code" varchar(100),
	"dough_operation_mode" varchar(20),
	"wrapping_mode" varchar(20),
	"ipfm_enabled" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	"ipfm_max_expiration_minutes" integer,
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_line_id_plant" UNIQUE("line_id","plant_id"),
	CONSTRAINT "uq_line_plant_code" UNIQUE("plant_id","line_code"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_line_dough_mode" CHECK (((dough_operation_mode IS NULL) OR ((dough_operation_mode)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MANUAL'::character varying, 'AUTOMATIC'::character varying, 'HYBRID'::character varying])::text[])))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_line_ipfm_expiration" CHECK (((ipfm_max_expiration_minutes IS NULL) OR (ipfm_max_expiration_minutes >= 0))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_line_wrapping_mode" CHECK (((wrapping_mode IS NULL) OR ((wrapping_mode)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MANUAL'::character varying, 'AUTOMATIC'::character varying, 'HYBRID'::character varying])::text[]))))
);

CREATE TABLE "scheduling"."dough_program" (
	"dough_program_id" uuid PRIMARY KEY,
	"dough_line_config_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"planned_dough_quantity" numeric(18, 6) NOT NULL,
	"quantity_uom_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"configured_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"planned_start_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"started_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"theoretical_finish_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"finished_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"status_code" varchar(30) NOT NULL,
	"finished_early" boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	"finish_reason" text,
	"source_system" varchar(50) DEFAULT 'GBC_APP' NOT NULL,
	"external_reference" varchar(200),
	"idempotency_key" varchar(200),
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_program_dates" CHECK ((((planned_start_at IS NULL) OR (planned_start_at >= configured_at)) AND ((started_at IS NULL) OR (started_at >= configured_at)) AND ((theoretical_finish_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (theoretical_finish_at >= started_at)) AND ((finished_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (finished_at >= started_at)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_program_finish_reason" CHECK (((finished_early = false) OR ((finish_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM finish_reason)) > 0)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_dough_program_quantity" CHECK ((planned_dough_quantity > (0)::numeric))
);

	"line_downtime_seconds" integer,
	"machine_downtime_seconds" integer,
	"comments" text,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "uq_stop_fragment_number" UNIQUE("stop_event_id","fragment_number"),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_stop_fragment_dates" CHECK (((fragment_ended_at IS NULL) OR (fragment_ended_at >= fragment_started_at))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_stop_fragment_durations" CHECK ((((line_downtime_seconds IS NULL) OR (line_downtime_seconds >= 0)) AND ((machine_downtime_seconds IS NULL) OR (machine_downtime_seconds >= 0)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_stop_fragment_number" CHECK ((fragment_number > 0))
);
CREATE TABLE "stops"."stop_program_link" (
	"stop_event_id" bigint,
	"dough_program_id" uuid,
	"relation_type" varchar(50),
	"linked_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"linked_by_user_id" bigint,
	CONSTRAINT "stop_program_link_pkey" PRIMARY KEY("stop_event_id","dough_program_id")
);
CREATE TABLE "stops"."supervisor_message" (
	"supervisor_message_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "stops"."supervisor_message_supervisor_message_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"recipient_user_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"sender_user_id" bigint,
	"stop_event_id" bigint,
	"message_type" varchar(50),
	"message_text" text NOT NULL,
	"sent_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"read_at" timestamp with time zone,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_supervisor_message_read" CHECK (((read_at IS NULL) OR (read_at >= sent_at))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_supervisor_message_text" CHECK ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM message_text)) > 0))
);
CREATE TABLE "waste"."extraordinary_waste" (
	"extraordinary_waste_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "waste"."extraordinary_waste_extraordinary_waste_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"original_waste_record_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"adjustment_type" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
	"adjustment_weight" numeric(18, 6) NOT NULL,
	"reason" text NOT NULL,
	"recorded_by_entra_tenant_id" uuid,
	"recorded_by_entra_object_id" uuid,
	"recorded_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"source_system" varchar(30) DEFAULT 'GBC_APP' NOT NULL,
	"oracle_transaction_id" varchar(150),
	"external_reference" varchar(150),
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_extraordinary_reason" CHECK ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reason)) > 0)),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_extraordinary_type" CHECK (((adjustment_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ADDITIONAL'::character varying, 'RETURN'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_extraordinary_weight" CHECK ((adjustment_weight > (0)::numeric))
);
CREATE TABLE "waste"."second_selection" (
	"second_selection_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "waste"."second_selection_second_selection_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"waste_record_id" bigint NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "second_selection_waste_record_id_key" UNIQUE,
	"region_variant" varchar(30) NOT NULL,
	"basket_count" integer,
	"pair_count" integer,
	"tray_count" integer,
	"packages_per_container" integer,
	"package_weight" numeric(18, 6),
	"second_selection_item_id" bigint,
	"piece_count" integer,
	"unit_weight" numeric(18, 6),
	"calculated_weight" numeric(18, 6),
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_second_selection_counts" CHECK ((((basket_count IS NULL) OR (basket_count >= 0)) AND ((pair_count IS NULL) OR (pair_count >= 0)) AND ((tray_count IS NULL) OR (tray_count >= 0)) AND ((packages_per_container IS NULL) OR (packages_per_container > 0)) AND ((piece_count IS NULL) OR (piece_count >= 0)))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_second_selection_mexico_pairs" CHECK ((((region_variant)::text <> 'MEXICO'::text) OR (pair_count IS NULL) OR (mod(pair_count, 2) = 0))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_second_selection_region" CHECK (((region_variant)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MEXICO'::character varying, 'BRAZIL'::character varying, 'CENTRAL_AMERICA'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_second_selection_weights" CHECK ((((package_weight IS NULL) OR (package_weight >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((unit_weight IS NULL) OR (unit_weight >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((calculated_weight IS NULL) OR (calculated_weight >= (0)::numeric))))
);
CREATE TABLE "waste"."waste_record" (
	"waste_record_id" bigint PRIMARY KEY GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY (sequence name "waste"."waste_record_waste_record_id_seq" INCREMENT BY 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 START WITH 1 CACHE 1),
	"line_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"shift_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"item_id" bigint,
	"waste_classification_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"waste_subclassification_id" bigint NOT NULL,
	"machine_area_id" bigint,
	"scale_code" varchar(100),
	"program_id" uuid,
	"weight" numeric(18, 6) NOT NULL,
	"weight_unit" varchar(20) DEFAULT 'KG' NOT NULL,
	"comments" text,
	"capture_type" varchar(30) DEFAULT 'MANUAL' NOT NULL,
	"recorded_by_entra_tenant_id" uuid,
	"recorded_by_entra_object_id" uuid,
	"recorded_at" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
	"source_system" varchar(30) DEFAULT 'GBC_APP' NOT NULL,
	"oracle_transaction_id" varchar(150),
	"oracle_item_code" varchar(100),
	"oracle_subinventory_code" varchar(100),
	"external_reference" varchar(150),
	"is_active" boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	"created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	"updated_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "ck_waste_record_capture_type" CHECK (((capture_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['MANUAL'::character varying, 'SCALE'::character varying, 'QR'::character varying, 'DESIGN_CALCULATED'::character varying, 'SYSTEM'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_waste_record_source" CHECK (((source_system)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['GBC_APP'::character varying, 'ORACLE'::character varying, 'WMS'::character varying, 'SCALE'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying])::text[]))),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_waste_record_weight" CHECK ((weight > (0)::numeric)),
	CONSTRAINT "ck_waste_record_weight_unit" CHECK (((weight_unit)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['KG'::character varying, 'G'::character varying, 'LB'::character varying, 'OTHER'::character varying])::text[])))
);

CREATE VIEW "databricks_auth_metrics" TABLESPACE public AS (SELECT metric, enum_name, enum_value, bucket_le, value FROM databricks_get_auth_metrics() p(metric text, enum_name text, enum_value text, bucket_le double precision, value double precision));
CREATE VIEW "databricks_list_roles" TABLESPACE public AS (SELECT role_name, identity_type FROM databricks_list_roles_impl() databricks_list_roles_impl(role_name, identity_type));
CREATE VIEW "databricks_synced_table_managers" TABLESPACE public AS (SELECT schema_name, table_name, user_name FROM databricks_synced_table_managers_impl() databricks_synced_table_managers_impl(schema_name, table_name, user_name));
CREATE VIEW "stops"."v_stop_current_classification" TABLESPACE stops AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.stop_event_id) e.stop_event_id, h.stop_classification_history_id, h.stop_classification_id, h.stop_subclassification_id, h.classification_source, h.classification_comment, h.changed_by_user_id, h.changed_at FROM stops.stop_event e LEFT JOIN stops.stop_classification_history h ON h.stop_event_id = e.stop_event_id ORDER BY e.stop_event_id, h.changed_at DESC NULLS LAST, h.stop_classification_history_id DESC NULLS LAST);
CREATE VIEW "stops"."v_stop_event_detail" TABLESPACE stops AS (SELECT e.stop_event_id, e.plant_id, e.line_id, e.machine_id, e.production_area_id, e.started_at, e.ended_at, e.detection_source, count(f.stop_fragment_id) AS fragment_count, COALESCE(sum(f.line_downtime_seconds), 0::bigint) AS total_line_downtime_seconds, COALESCE(sum(f.machine_downtime_seconds), 0::bigint) AS total_machine_downtime_seconds FROM stops.stop_event e LEFT JOIN stops.stop_fragment f ON f.stop_event_id = e.stop_event_id GROUP BY e.stop_event_id, e.plant_id, e.line_id, e.machine_id, e.production_area_id, e.started_at, e.ended_at, e.detection_source);
